testCase:
H-08: Date, time, colour and range fields
Goal: Book a stay with check-in on 20 November 2026, arrival at 14:30, room colour #336699 and 3 guests.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/h-08/
STEP 2: Fill "Check-in date" with "2026-11-20"
STEP 3: Fill "Arrival time" with "14:30"
STEP 4: Fill "Room colour" with "#336699"
STEP 5: Set "Guests" to 3
STEP 6: Click "Book"
STEP 7: Verify "Booked: 2026-11-20 14:30 #336699 3 guests" is visible
